transcript.text: Alright everyone, we need to discuss the medical-device housing run scheduled for Thursday. As you know, our available virgin polymer is insufficient to complete the planned batch, but there is a lot of reclaimed polymer pellets in the materials cage that hasn't yet been authorized for this product. I understand that if we use the reclaimed lot at a 15% blend, the virgin polymer we have is sufficient to cover the required 85% virgin portion. Before I can make any authorization decision, I need quality and environmental compliance to state their exact requirements and confirm which controls they will complete before the scheduled run. Once both responses are on the record, I'll settle the authorization and control plan. So let's hear from quality and environmental compliance first.

transcript.text: I need to share my completed lab review findings. The reclaimed polymer is suitable for this housing only at a 15% reclaimed-to-85% virgin blend. Additionally, I confirmed that the first 50 molded housings must receive FTIR identity testing, but I should note that the lab result has not yet been attached to the production traveler. As Quality, my requirements are: the blend must be held to exactly 15% reclaimed / 85% virgin, and the first 50 housings must undergo FTIR identity testing with results documented on the production traveler before the run can proceed. I will complete the FTIR testing and ensure the lab result is attached to the production traveler before Thursday's run.

transcript.text: I need to share my environmental compliance findings. My review of the supplier's revised safety data sheet — received late yesterday and not yet entered in the plant's chemical register — classifies the reclaimed lot's additive residue as regulated process waste. This requires labeled segregated storage and a hazardous-waste manifest for any discarded pellets or purge material. As Environmental Compliance, my requirements are: the reclaimed lot must be stored in labeled segregated storage, and a hazardous-waste manifest must be in place for any discarded pellets or purge material. I can complete the chemical-register entry, storage setup, and manifest procedures before Thursday's run, and I will provide environmental-compliance sign-off once those controls are complete.
